sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Package A: our standard counter, first.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. It is always a pleasure to build on the long relationship between our companies, and we are open to securing your supply with a 24-month contract, as long-term partnerships are the foundation of our foundry.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. However, we must retain our standard 30-day payment terms to manage our operations effectively. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €51.90 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We note that your latest proposal remains unchanged from your previous offer. 

Our family-run foundry has always valued the long-standing partnership we share with your esteemed company. Over the years, our dedication to quality and regional craft has guided our shared success. In this spirit, we have already made a significant step towards your position by accepting the 24-month contract and offering flexible payment options. However, as a family-run business, we must ask for a step from your side before we can adjust our offer further. 

For your reference, our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We note that your latest proposal remains unchanged once again. As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long-standing partnership, but we cannot make further concessions without a meaningful step from your side. We must therefore maintain our current offer of €52.30 per unit.

For our part, our offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please keep in mind that this proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Our foundry has always taken pride in delivering reliable quality to your company over many years. We truly cherish the strong bond between our businesses, yet a fair balance is necessary for us to continue moving forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

As a family-run business that values our long-standing partnership, we have already made concessions on contract length and payment terms. We must therefore hold our offer at €52.30 and kindly ask for a meaningful step from your side before we can proceed.

Our offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
